class: proxy state used for user intent

steps: src/panel/panel.js:158 sets the range to the placeholder default
src/panel/panel.js:605 firstLoad skips the move because rangePicked is true

fix: Reset rangePicked when clearFilter returns to the default.
impact: Panel stays on 7d for the session; the setting is ignored for the shown range.
mechanism: clearFilter returns to state.defaultRange but leaves rangePicked true, so firstLoad will not move to the real default.
sweep: clearFilter is the only path that sets the range back to the default (panel.js:158); range clicks and Apply are real picks.
title: Clearing a custom range before the Default range is read pins the 7d placeholder
trigger: 1. Setting read is slow; saved default 30d. 2. Custom → Apply. 3. Clear the range chip (goes to 7d placeholder). 4. Read answers 30d.
